status: PROPOSED. Nothing here has been generated or published. Needs Mbanda’s written approval of the likeness set first.
identity: Use the attached original photographs as identity references for exactly the same man, Mbanda Shyaka: long narrow face, mature natural facial lines, warm dark skin, full salt-and-pepper beard, long dreadlocks held under a close black headwrap, lean athletic build with natural proportions, and the necklace shown in the reference photographs. Wardrobe: charcoal sleeveless walking vest, weathered compact dark backpack. Do not alter his face, age or build.
style: Unposed documentary photograph, 35mm lens, ordinary natural daylight (overcast or open shade preferred), muted honest colour, real texture on skin, cloth, dust and metal, slightly imperfect framing with the subject off-centre. His attention is on the task or the road, not the camera. Any other people are adults shown from behind, in profile or partly cropped, and are doing something of their own. The foreground may be partly blocked by a passing object or person. Believable Ugandan roadside and trading-centre settings. The look of a photojournalist's contact sheet, not an advertisement.
negative: No text, numbers, signs, banners, logos, Rotary or club emblems, licence plates, mileage or tracker overlays. No children's faces. No named place, stage, milestone or event. No golden-hour glow, mist, light shafts or lens flare. No looking into the lens. No staged laughing group, no handshake pose, no hero pose. No extra fingers, no duplicated people, no melted hands or boots.

captionRule.note: Illustrates the walks. Not a record of a specific place, day, stage, person or project.

assemble: prompt = style + " Scene: " + scene + " " + (kind === "person" ? identity + " " : "") + negative + " Aspect ratio " + aspect + "."
